messages:
olivia (audits): planning a targeted admin-entitlement cleanup next Wed 10:00 PT. Scope: org-level admin roles + cross-account KMS grants + any vendor principals. Goal: ~30% entitlement reduction, attach owner attestation for removals.

jess (engsec): whats the safety net if a CI pipeline or infra job loses permissions mid-rollout?

olivia (audits): rollback via emergency svc-account with 1h TTL + step-by-step runbook. We'll run canaries in staging first. Runbook draft: https://go/runbooks/admin-prune (internal).

raj (infra): share the KMS binding enumeration query so I can run it on the staging audit replica.

olivia (audits): using auditdb (read-only):
```
SELECT principal, resource, binding_id, granted_by, created_at
FROM kms_bindings
WHERE account != resource_account AND role ILIKE '%admin%'
AND NOT tags @> ARRAY['auto-allowed']
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
```
Filter note: exclude svc-accts tagged auto-allowed; include vendor principals.

mike (sre): add me to canary watchers. I'll monitor cloudlogs, latency, and job failures.

anna (platform): last sweep missed a vendor binding. How are vendor principals attested?

olivia (audits): owners-bot will open attestation tickets for vendor principals; owner must respond before removal. We'll escalate after 48h no-response.

jess (engsec): vuln triage: two high sev issues relate to role escalation when bindings change. Patch APR-22 mitigates it. Recommend gating mass prune until APR-22 is deployed everywhere.

olivia (audits): acknowledged. Gate condition added: "APR-22 deployed to all prod regions".

anna (platform): condensed checklist:
- create staging canary group (5 services)
- run KMS-binding query + export CSV
- owners-bot open attestation tickets
- apply least-priv template to flagged bindings (smallest role that passes smoke tests)
- monitor telemetry 2h; rollback threshold: error-rate >1% or any failed CI jobs
- collect audit bundle (logs, attestation, before/after diffs)

raj (infra): owners-bot mapping note  ensure group aliases (e.g., owner:platform-team) are treated as valid owners, do not auto-remove.

owners-bot: attestation tickets created: 14 open, 5 vendor principals flagged.

mike (sre): I'll run a 15-minute simulated permission regression during the canary to exercise rollback runbook.

olivia (audits): thanks. I'll post the PR with the target list and the runbook in #eng-security tomorrow AM. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:

anna (platform): also add a step to snapshot current KMS policy bindings (JSON) before changes so we can diff and reapply if needed.

jess (engsec): and include a post-change verification script: smoke-run of deploy jobs + a KV read/write test for services touching KMS.

olivia (audits): added both to checklist. Scheduling canary for 2026-04-01T17:00Z.

owners-bot: deploy scheduled: admin-prune-canary by olivia  2026-04-01T17:00Z
